howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.sourcingBody: Pieces are found one by one at flea markets, car boot sales and second-hand shops.
howItWorks.selectionBody: Every garment is washed, checked and measured. Actual measurements in centimetres are listed on the item page, along with any flaws.
howItWorks.shippingBody: Dispatched within 48 working hours from France, to a pickup point or to your address.
